card.name: Inside new brand drug names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of newer brand-name drugs written in capitals, such as BIXLENVO, UPTRAVI, SUNLENCA and VABOMERE, when the name is split into parts. It fires on a piece before the name is complete, not on the last piece.

modes.label: Second piece of a split name
modes.description: The second piece of a brand name split into several parts, with the ending still to come.
modes.example: BIX<<LEN>>VO must be taken with SUNLENCA

modes.label: Later piece of a compound name
modes.description: A piece inside a longer brand name, including names with a suffix like FASPRO.
modes.example: Interrupt RYBREVANT F<<AS>>PRO injection if ARR is suspected

card.plain: It marks the middle of an unfamiliar brand drug name that has been split into pieces.
